t: This is 40 Bank Street, a skyscraper in Heron Quays, overlooking the London Docklands. It stands about 153 metres tall, with 30 storeys, and was built in 2003 by Canary Wharf Contractors. The design is by Cesar Pelli and Associates, led by the Argentine-American architect César Pelli, with Adamson Associates as executive architect. It is currently listed as the thirty-eighth tallest building in London, which tells you how crowded the skyline around you has become.
